R0216.title: Virtual Asset Cross-Platform Transfer Risk
R0216.definition: Virtual asset interoperability protocols between metaverse platforms have vulnerabilities that may cause asset transfer failures, double-spending or theft.

references.title: Interoperability security for metaverse virtual assets

R0216.description:
Virtual asset cross-platform transfer risk appears when assets move across metaverse platforms, games, wallets, or marketplaces. Protocol flaws, synchronization failures, or authorization gaps can cause loss, double spend, or theft.

Interoperability increases liquidity but connects the trust boundaries of multiple platforms. Designs need clear custody rules, finality, rollback handling, and dispute processes.
R0216.influence: Cross-platform asset transfer flaws can cause virtual asset theft, loss, or double spend across connected metaverse platforms.
